remarks: Welcome to 8271 Dancy Circle, a beautifully maintained single-story home nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Huntington Beach. Offering 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and 1,943 square feet of living space, this home reflects true pride of ownership. Its comfortable, thoughtfully designed floor plan creates an inviting atmosphere with endless possibilities to make it your own. Updated bathrooms add a modern touch, while the spacious 6,200-square-foot lot features one of the larger backyards in the neighborhood, offering exceptional space for entertaining, relaxing, or creating your own outdoor retreat.
